tools.name: workspace.context
tools.description: Preflight context for ChatGPT Web coding. Call before workspace tools.
tools.docsSummary: Returns the current policy, tool surface, host constraints, project/task summaries, and first-call guidance.

tools.name: workspace.scan
tools.description: Deep workspace scan for project manifests, languages, tools, task files, and codegen.
tools.docsSummary: Scans manifests, task/config files, frontend/codegen/database markers, and workspace candidates with explicit effective options.

tools.name: workspace.symbols
tools.description: Query workspace symbol definitions and imports.
tools.docsSummary: Returns lightweight TypeScript/JavaScript declarations and imports for bounded symbol discovery.

tools.name: fs.tree
tools.description: Return a bounded workspace file tree while skipping protected paths.
tools.docsSummary: Lists files and directories with maxDepth, maxEntries, include/exclude, hidden, ignored, and cursor controls.

tools.name: fs.search
tools.description: Search workspace text while skipping protected paths.
tools.docsSummary: Searches text with fixed or regex mode, include/exclude globs, context lines, and gitignore/hidden/ignored controls.

tools.name: fs.read
tools.description: Read one workspace file in a bounded UTF-8 byte chunk.
tools.docsSummary: Reads one file by byteOffset or line range. Use nextOffsetBytes as byteOffset for continuation.

tools.name: fs.read_many
tools.description: Read multiple workspace files in bounded UTF-8 byte chunks.
tools.docsSummary: Reads several files either with simple paths plus shared options or advanced per-file options.

tools.name: fs.stat
tools.description: Return metadata for one or more workspace paths.
tools.docsSummary: Returns existence, type, size, hashes, and timestamps for up to 100 paths.

tools.name: fs.manifest
tools.description: Return manifest entries with hashes for workspace paths.
tools.docsSummary: Returns hash-ready manifest entries using sizeBytes, mtimeMs, and sha256 for files.

tools.name: file.change_preview
tools.description: Validate and diff one logical workspace file change.
tools.docsSummary: Previews exactly one logical file change and returns an envelope with preview data.

tools.name: file.change_apply
tools.description: Apply one logical workspace file change after preview.
tools.docsSummary: Applies exactly one previously previewed logical file change with a matching previewHash.

tools.name: batch.change_preview
tools.description: Validate and diff a batch workspace change.
tools.docsSummary: Previews a policy-enabled batch changeset and returns an envelope with preview data.

tools.name: batch.change_apply
tools.description: Apply a batch workspace change after preview.
tools.docsSummary: Applies a previously previewed batch changeset with a matching previewHash.

tools.name: change.preview
tools.description: Validate and diff a batch workspace change.
tools.docsSummary: Previews a policy-enabled batch changeset and returns an envelope with preview data.

tools.name: change.apply
tools.description: Apply a batch workspace change after preview.
tools.docsSummary: Applies a previously previewed batch changeset with a matching previewHash.

tools.name: manual.prepare
tools.description: Prepare low-risk manual continuation metadata before showing manual instructions and opening manual.gate.
tools.docsSummary: Stores low-risk continuation metadata only; commands, diffs, stdout, stderr, logs, and content are rejected.

tools.name: manual.gate
tools.description: Open a manual barrier after manual instructions were shown in chat.

hostObservation.outputText: manual step required because required execution capability is unavailable
manual step required because required execution capability is unavailable

tools.docsSummary: Opens the local manual barrier with v1 proof fields and low-risk hostObservation only.

tools.name: manual.status
tools.description: Report current pending manual action for this caller.
tools.docsSummary: Reports whether a manual barrier is pending and which resume route to use.

tools.name: manual.resume
tools.description: Resume or cancel a pending manual action from a later user message that starts with /resume.
tools.docsSummary: Validates the /resume control message, records optional log evidence, and verifies configured checks.

tools.name: task.list
tools.description: List available and unavailable policy-defined tasks.
tools.docsSummary: Returns configured task availability, resolver checks, unavailable reasons, and candidates.

tools.name: task.explain
tools.description: Explain resolver checks and next route for one taskId or candidate task id.
tools.docsSummary: Explains whether a task ID is runnable, unavailable, candidate-only, or manual-first.

tools.name: task.run
tools.description: Run one policy-defined local task by taskId. No free-form command input.
tools.docsSummary: Runs only configured or policy-allowed candidate task IDs and returns bounded log summaries.

tools.name: task.result
tools.description: Read task run status and log summaries by runId.
tools.docsSummary: Reads a foreground or background task record by runId.

tools.name: git.status
tools.description: Show concise Git worktree status.
tools.docsSummary: Returns branch, head, clean flag, and concise porcelain stdout.

tools.name: git.changed
tools.description: Show changed files.
tools.docsSummary: Returns staged, unstaged, untracked, and combined changed path lists.

tools.name: git.diff
tools.description: Show staged or unstaged Git diff for the workspace or one path.
tools.docsSummary: Returns bounded staged or unstaged diff stdout with cursor-based byte continuation.

tools.name: git.show
tools.description: Show one Git revision with stat and patch.
tools.docsSummary: Returns a bounded revision stat and patch with cursor-based byte continuation.

tools.name: git.blame
tools.description: Show Git line blame for a workspace file.
tools.docsSummary: Returns porcelain blame metadata for one workspace file and line range.

tools.name: git.commit_preview
tools.description: Preview an explicit-path Git commit without writing it.
tools.docsSummary: Uses a temporary index to preview the exact explicit paths that git.commit can commit.

tools.name: git.commit
tools.description: Commit only explicit workspace-relative paths with the provided message.
tools.docsSummary: Creates a commit only after git.commit_preview returns a matching previewHash.

tools.name: diagnostics.health
tools.description: Return webvibe relay diagnostics, tool surface version, hashes, and upstream health.
tools.docsSummary: Reports relay, policy, tool surface, instruction, upstream, and recent tool error diagnostics.
